# Toy Story Toy Quiz Skill

This skill runs a short, unofficial Toy Story toy quiz in chat, just for fun. It asks ten original questions one by one, keeps the score hidden, and names the toy that fits your answers best, with a short explanation. It is not a personality test, and it is not an official quiz.

Unofficial fan quiz. Not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to Disney or Pixar. No official text, image, emblem, music, or quiz is copied here. Just for fun, not a real personality test.
